clips.text: Are you really aware of what anger is?
Are you really aware of it when it is present?
I ask these questions because man is never present in the present.
Man lives in the past and only becomes aware of anything when it has become a part of his memory.

One becomes aware of anger and sadness only when they are all over, and then awareness is just pseudo-awareness; it is not awareness but remembering, and remembering leads nowhere because it is running in a circle.
Then one can fight with anger but can never understand it, and fighting with anger is anger - of course more subtle
and therefore more strong and more poisonous.
So do not think about anger or sadness or happiness and do not understand remembrance to be awareness but be aware when anger is present.
Be totally conscious of it, live it consciously and do not escape from it and then you will know what it is.
